English: (I hang the picture on the wall. The picture hangs on the wall.)

English: (Instead of a car, he bought a bicycle.)

English: (I put the book on the table. The book lies on the table.)

English: (There are trees on both sides of the street.)

English: (I work until 6 PM. The train goes to Cologne.)
